title: SPT.GH.------INFO.DE.(B)
description: Chart on book p. 503 (TRF(II)-39). SPT-GH (spiritual growth) is the subject; INFO-DE-B (information degrees) is the partner. From the subject: PER-DY (perception dynamics), VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) and WO-UNF (world unification). From PER-DY: MT-INTR (multiple interpretation). From MT-INTR: LK-IMP (linkage implications). From LK-IMP: BIA (bi-aitional). From VT-DY: AFI (affinity insight). From AFI: POST (postulation). From WO-UNF: EXT-CONT-1. From EXT-CONT-1: ALT-C-PROG.
